name: bore
notes: A rock drill with the feed taken off it, so the whole of what it does goes down the bore. It does not fire rounds: hold the left button and it puts out a turning rope of cutting light that takes a ball out of whatever it is held on, over and over, until the hole is through and the hole is a sightline. The right button runs the drill backwards: it throws what the left button cut out of the walls back out of the gun as half-metre blocks of the map's own rock, lobbed across the room, and where one lands it stays. Wall up a doorway, build a step to a ledge, or drop one on somebody's head, which is the only one of the three that does not leave a block behind. It is the only weapon in the arena that changes the arena, and the reason nobody holds a corner for long.
